Basic **SVO order**: subject + verb + object (She reads books.)
**SVOO**: subject + verb + indirect object + direct object (She gave him a present.)
**SVOC**: subject + verb + object + complement (They made her captain.)
**Adverb placement**: between subject and verb, after be (She always arrives early.)
**Adverb placement**: at the beginning or end of a sentence for emphasis
**Inversion** after negative adverbs (Never have I seen… Rarely does he…)

**Time, manner, place** order for adverbs/phrases (She sang beautifully at the concert last night.)
